scope_items.description: Phase 1: add num_layers defaulted kwarg to CustomWeights AND delete xfail marker from P0 test in a single commit
Phase 2: port noisy_same_class_mixup and efficient_batch_same_class_mixup from SINCHI repo; pure torch+numpy; do NOT edit src/utils/__init__.py
Phase 3: optional-deps wiring (requirements-dinov3.txt new; requirements.txt single comment line) + Custom_Crop image_size kwarg + update I11 hash in test_invariants.py + 2 new tests

anti_narrowing_clause: This ledger covers Phases 1, 2, and 3 of docs/design/dinov3-integration/final.md. Phases 0 (already converged) and 4-9 are explicitly out of scope. P1 is the only allowed edit to src/models/classification/resnet_base/custom_weights.py. P3 is the only allowed edit to src/datasets/custom.py, requirements.txt, and tests/regression/test_invariants.py (I11 hash update). P2 is purely additive (no edits to existing files). New in-scope subtasks may be APPENDED with added_round marker; existing entries may NEVER be removed.
